Regular patrolling, strict penalties, and increased surveillance through cameras can help reduce accidents. Public awareness campaigns on responsible driving are also necessary. An effective way to restore safe driving habits is through celebrity-endorsed road safety campaigns. Celebrities influence public behavior, and their involvement can encourage drivers to follow traffic rules. Their participation in awareness programs and social media campaigns reinforces responsible driving. To combat road dangers, a combined effort from the government, law enforcement, and the public is essential.
